quote: Tasks. We follow previous works to implement self-correction in simple factual questions with Yes/No answers and complex tasks. • Yes/No questions. We evaluate LLMs' capability of answering Yes/No on natural questions. • Decision making. We require LLMs to take actions step-by-step... • Reasoning. This measures LLMs' performance of parsing content and reasoning over several supporting documents. • Programming. We assess LLMs' performance of generating code blocks and text paragraphs...
We assess LLMs' performance of generating code blocks ... using the HumanEval dataset, consisting of 161 functions.
We assess LLMs' performance of generating code blocks and text paragraphs that reason through the problem based on function signatures accompanied by docstrings.
outputs: Generated answers (e.g., 'Yes' or 'No'), step-by-step actions, reasoning explanations, and code implementations.
